$comment: The one definition of which changed paths start which checks. scripts/pre-pr (through routing.py) and auto-revert.mjs (through routing.mjs) read it directly. Workflow `paths:` filters cannot read a file, so each route lists the YAML lists it is copied into; `python3 scripts/ci/routing.py --write` rewrites them and `python3 scripts/ci/routing.py` (run by make test-tooling) fails when they drift. Patterns use GitHub's path-filter globs: `**` spans directories, `*` stays inside one.

apple.description: CI Lint and the tooling tests: every path outside docs, the website, the native Android app and the Workers package.

swift.description: The macOS job and Portable Swift (Linux): Swift package inputs and the scripts those jobs run. CI-only edits do not select them; add `ci:full` to exercise a workflow change.

api.description: Public API compatibility: the exported library products' sources, the manifest and the gate. pre-pr also runs the check when the CI job's own script changes.

ios.description: The pull-request iOS simulator compile: shared and iOS library sources.

android.description: The Android workflow on main (pre-pr runs it before the merge): the app, its workflow and the shared Swift definitions its parity tests read.

windows.description: pre-pr only: the Windows Swift type check (linux.yml runs it in CI).

workflows.description: pre-pr only: reported as an area; scripts/quality check runs actionlint over changed workflows.

shell.description: pre-pr only: reported as an area; scripts/quality check runs ShellCheck over changed shell scripts.

paid-access-worker.description: pre-pr only: the Workers package's npm checks (ci.yml's paid-access-worker job runs on every untrusted pull request).

landing-page.description: pre-pr only: the landing page tests.
